title: Quietly Simmered Malaysian Beef Curry
description: A comforting Malaysian dish featuring charred and glassy jelly-like texture, made with ground ginger and rest meat, suitable for diabetics. This recipe is cooked in a terracotta dish for enhanced flavor.
instructions: Heat oil in a large terracotta dish over medium heat.
Add the beef chunks and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the ground ginger, curry powder, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, beef broth, fish sauce, brown sugar, salt, and pepper, and stir well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2.5 hours.
Remove the dish from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions.
Refrigerate or freeze the leftovers for later use.
Reheat the curry over low heat before serving.
